description: Eight-stage shift register clocked from a jack or from its own tempo, with a gate output for each stage and the whole register as a voltage

params.text: Pressing it adds one to the shift register
Sets the tempo of the internal clock in beats per minute, used whenever nothing is patched into the clock input

inputs.text: The clock; a rising edge past 1V shifts the register along one stage, and with nothing patched the internal clock runs instead
A gate here adds one to the shift register
Adds to the shift register in proportion to its voltage, a tenth of a volt for each step, up to 127 either way

outputs.text: High while this stage of the register holds a one
The whole eight-bit register as a voltage, 0-10V

notes: with nothing patched into the clock input the module clocks itself at the tempo knob's rate, so it runs as soon as it is placed.
menu: Pulse Mode: Gate, Trig — sets whether a stage output stays high for as long as that stage holds a one or fires a brief pulse when it takes one

inputs.0:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the internal clock; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
